entries.back_en: Does this mean Princess Elina isn't going to come back?
I didn't know what to think when I received word from Ludia that you'd been captured.
What should I think? My daughter goes out searching for her missing sister, only to be caught trespassing in enemy territory... How did this happen?
I beg your forgiveness, Majesty. It's my fault. If it weren't for me...
As you probably discovered for yourself, our neighbor and supposed ally Ludia is more worried about its relations with the Empire than helping me search for my daughter.
So, what do you intend to do now? Sooner or later the Ludians are bound to discover you are here. We'll do everything we can to protect you...
I see... But... Although I'm king of Wyndia, I have no control over the dragon... You know that.
Hmmm... I see... Very well. Go to the woods east of here. There you'll find the Oracle of Wind, a priestess who serves the Wind Dragon.
The King was placed in a very difficult position... On one hand he has to protect his daughter, Princess [04], and on the other he has to maintain our relations with Ludia.
I pity the poor King... Although he worries about Princess Elina more than anyone, he doesn't discuss the matter with anyone in public. It hurts my heart to see him like this...
The [09][07][05] is an ancient holy relic needed to enter the Tower of Wind, sacred to the Wind Dragon. It is kept in a safe place beneath the castle.
We heard reports that Ludian troops were seen near the castle. You must hurry before they find out you are here!
Princess Elina is engaged to marry the Prince of Ludia... Princess [04] is next in line to the throne... Which should I choose-- a love that is wrong, or a love that cannot be?
Wait... If Princess [04] and I are joined, that means one day I'll be King of Wyndia... Will I be able to handle the responsibility?
If I marry Princess Elina, that means the entire country of Ludia will be after us... Will I be able to protect her from them?
entries.note: 'o inteiro pais' soa anti-natural; usar 'o pais inteiro de Ludia'.

entries.back_en: Hmmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? Now I understand why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck.
Hmmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? Now I understand why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck.
[04]... There's little I can do for you now. You've grown much, my daughter. You are strong enough to fight your own battles now. I am very proud of you!
Princess Elina still hasn't returned... I only pray nothing happens to Princess [04]...!
If I marry Princess [04], all of this... The town, the people... All of it will be mine! Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha ha!
Ah, Princess [04]! For a moment I almost mistook you for your sister. You've grown much in these last days-- more confident, more mature. If only she were here!
Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha! Look at the crowd down there! Looks like an ant! An insect! Bwah ha ha ha ha!
entries.note: 'turba' e singular 'formiga/inseto' alteram o tom; original e 'the people... like ants! Insects!' no plural.
